# Working idea: restaurant ops software for small independent restaurants

Idea: A simple, cheap web app that tracks inventory and supplier orders, flags food-cost creep, and builds weekly prep and staff schedules. Built with Python and web tech, priced for owners who will not pay enterprise software prices.

First steps: Interview 10 local owners, build a prototype of the inventory and food-cost view, run a paid pilot with my parents' restaurant and 1-2 neighbors.
